name: Yueren (Moon Elves)
body:
The yueren are an ancient, nocturnal offshoot of the elven race deeply attuned to the lunar cycle and the interplay between shadow and light. They divide themselves into two distinct castes—the reflective, intuitive Yueyinren and the bold, dynamic Yueyangren.

Standard Racial Traits
Ability Score Racial Traits (Yueyinren): Yueyinren are agile and spiritually profound, but frail. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Wisdom, and -2 Constitution.
Ability Score Racial Traits (Yueyangren): Yueyangren are nimble and forceful, but physically slender. They gain +2 Dexterity, +2 Charisma, and -2 Constitution.
Type: Humanoid (elf). Yueren are humanoids with the elf subtype.
Size: Medium. Yueren have no bonuses or penalties due to their size.
Speed: Normal. Yueren have a base land speed of 30 feet.
Languages: Yueren begin play speaking Common and Elven. Bonus languages include Celestial, Draconic, Goblin, Orc, and Sylvan.
Senses and Defense Racial Traits
Low-Light Vision: Yueren can see twice as far as humans in conditions of dim light.
Elven Immunities: Yueren are immune to magic sleep effects and gain a +2 racial saving throw bonus against enchantment spells and effects.
Magical and Skill Racial Traits
Keen Senses: Yueren receive a +2 racial bonus on Perception checks.
Moonlight Stride (Su): While in conditions of dim light or darkness, a yueren gains a +2 racial bonus on Stealth checks and their base land speed increases by +5 feet.
Lunar Radiance (Sp): A yueren can cast light at will as a spell-like ability (caster level equal to character level), but the light emitted is pale silvery-blue like moonlight. Once per day, a yueren can cast faerie fire as a spell-like ability.
Weapon Familiarity
Yueren Weapon Familiarity: Yueren are proficient with the longbow, composite longbow, shortbow, composite shortbow, and any weapon with the word “elven” in its name, and treat any exotic weapon with the word “elven” in its name as a martial weapon.
